summary.text: Dave Buehler, listed by Ballotpedia as David Buehler, is a Republican state representative who has represented Kansas House District 40 since 2023 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026. A retired U.S. Navy captain and former Hallmark Cards production manager, he chairs the Social Services Budget Committee.

paragraphs.text: Buehler served in the U.S. Navy and reached the rank of captain.
He earned a B.B.A. from the University of Missouri at Kansas City in 1984 and an M.A. in management from Webster University in 1993.
His career experience includes working as a production manager with Hallmark Cards.
Buehler served on the board of directors of the Alliance Against Family Violence and has been affiliated with United Way of Leavenworth County.
Buehler took office in the Kansas House on January 9, 2023, succeeding Representative David French.

During the 2025-2026 session he served on the Appropriations, Health and Human Services, and Robert G. (Bob) Bethell Joint Committee on Home and Community Based Services and KanCare Oversight committees, and as chair of the Social Services Budget Committee.
